issue_context.title: [Feature] Migrate to Vite 5
issue_context.body:
Vite 5 uses Rollup 4 which improves the performance of the production build of the component testing feature. related to: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/14748#issuecomment-1837101714

Migration guide: https://vitejs.dev/guide/migration _(deprecate CJS and use Node.js 18 or 20+)_
Release notes: https://vitejs.dev/blog/announcing-vite5

review_comments: It is still there, but is no longer boolean. My change retains the behavior, but as per the deprecation message it starts https w/o a certificate. So we can probably remove it.
